decisions.reason: The source changes how initial Airbnb hosts are selected and contacted, not how interested hosts are advanced after responding.
The simplified host-selection and outreach method does not alter spreadsheet tracking or the trigger for entering interested hosts into the CRM.
The source does not discuss storage, linked documents, or submission of completed task artifacts.
Daily Airbnb outreach remains in the assignment set unchanged; specifying its internal selection and messaging method does not change the completion requirement or deadline.
The source concerns selecting Airbnb hosts and sending outreach messages, not selecting CJ Dropshipping products.
The Airbnb outreach method does not affect TikTok Shop product publication.
The source provides task-specific instructions for Airbnb outreach but does not change the general fallback rules for independently choosing routine work.
The source does not alter Shopify product selection, publication, categorization, batch size, or timing.
The source does not discuss or change cross-channel product-listing spreadsheet records.
The source concerns Airbnb outreach execution and does not affect the CRM structure document's content, location, or visibility.
